description: List every run of one mapping job, newest first, by the job's `id` (from listMappings): each run has an id, runNumber (1 is the first), status (running, completed, failed or limited, with limitReason), stats, inFlightCount, probeMode and start and finish times; plus totalRuns. Use when: the user asks how a map has changed over time or when it was last mapped. Pass a runNumber as `version` to getMapping or getMappingTree to read that run. Read-only. Needs mapping:read. Returns 404 if the job is not in your workspace.
name: listMappingRuns

outputSchema.description: Response from `GET /mapping/{id}/runs`. Run history sorted newest-first.

items.description:
Execution state for a single run of a mapping job. Each `POST /mapping/{id}/start`
creates a new run (incrementing `runNumber`); `remap` creates a new run too.

carrier.description:
Bring-your-own-carrier (invite-only): the carrier route this run was started through.
Every call of the run dials through it. Absent when the run dialled normally.

copyFromRun.description: When restarting with excludes, copies step data from this prior run.

limitReason.description: Reason the run stopped early (only present when `status` is `limited`).

probeMode.description: Whether probe mode was active for this run.

stats.description: Aggregate statistics for the current run, populated while the job executes.

loopsDetected.description: Number of times a repeated menu was detected.

retriedCalls.description: Calls that required at least one retry.

totalCalls.description: Total calls placed so far in this run.

totalRuns.description: Total number of runs (for client-side pagination convenience).

title: List Mapping Job Runs
